enactment.title: Larkspur Bend Mobile Food Vendor Ordinance

fictionalProvenance.author: 0805_Claude_Opus55_S46INT
fictionalProvenance.attestation: Original fiction written for S46; no copied text.

sections.heading: Definitions
sections.text: In this ordinance, "vendor" means a person who sells prepared food from a mobile food cart inside the Town of Larkspur Bend.

sections.heading: Permits
sections.text:
(a) A vendor shall hold a mobile vending permit from the Town Clerk.
(b) A vendor may not sell food from a cart parked inside Heron Green Park.

sections.heading: Renewal
sections.text:
(a) A vendor shall renew the mobile vending permit within thirty (30) calendar days after the vendor receives a renewal notice.
(b) Renewal applications shall be filed with the Town Clerk.
(c) A vendor need not renew a permit that the vendor has surrendered.

sections.heading: Inspections
sections.text:
(a) A vendor shall present the cart for a fire safety inspection within ten (10) calendar days after the Fire Marshal requests an inspection.
(b) The Fire Marshal shall post each inspection result on the Town notice board.

sections.heading: Noise
sections.text:
(a) No vendor shall run a generator inside a residential block.
(b) A vendor may play recorded music at a low volume.

sections.heading: Short title
sections.text: This ordinance may be cited as the Larkspur Bend Mobile Food Vendor Ordinance.

amendments.instructionText: Sec. 5 is amended to set quiet hours for vending near homes and to allow generators on festival days.
In Sec. 1, after "from a mobile food cart" insert "or a food truck". In Sec. 4(a), strike "ten (10)" and insert "seven (7)".

operations.new: from a mobile food cart or a food truck
